verdict.rationale: Bitwarden ships an official, fully featured CLI (bw) for headless vault access. Its personal API key is documented as suitable for automated workflows, `bw serve` exposes the vault as a local REST API, and a runtime probe confirmed the CLI installs keylessly from npm and runs. A hands-on community report confirms the CLI works non-interactively, though `bw list` outputs secrets in plaintext, which matters for CI log hygiene. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline integration docs (e.g., CI runner recipes), independent corroboration of an end-to-end authenticated headless run in CI.
